'''Miner''' is a [[Keeper]] [[perk]] available in the [[Inspirations/Metallurgy|Metallurgy talent tree]].

== Prerequisites ==
*{{Mastery|Red}} Red mastery +1

== Effects ==
+1 {{Item|Copper Nugget}} from the copper vein<br/>20% chance to get {{Item|Gem}} in the copper vein<br/>+1 {{Item|Iron Ore}} from a iron deposit
